nodes.name: GET /rate
nodes.notes: Where the stars in the email point. It only SHOWS a confirm page — it writes nothing. Email security scanners (Outlook Safe Links, Mimecast, Proofpoint…) fetch every link in a message, so a GET that recorded the rating would let a scanner rate on the user's behalf. The write happens on POST /rate-submit, which a scanner doesn't send. The PRODUCTION url of this node, minus the trailing /rate, is what goes in the other workflow's Config.webhookBase.

nodes.name: POST /rate-comment
nodes.notes: Where the optional comment box on the thank-you page posts to. Same token, so it needs no separate credential.

nodes.name: Record rating
nodes.notes: neverError is deliberate: a bad or expired token should reach the page builder below and become a readable sentence, not a red 500 in the user's browser. Auth is a Header Auth credential with header name "apikey" and the Supabase SECRET key as the value — this project uses the new sb_secret_ key format, which is not a JWT, so Authorization: Bearer does not work on it.

nodes.name: Confirm page
nodes.notes: Shows the chosen rating with a Submit button. No database call.

nodes.name: POST /rate-submit
nodes.notes: Where the confirm page's Submit button posts (token, rating, optional comment). The only route that records a rating.
